result_text:
The full `mvn -o test` run finished with exit code 0 and printed no failures, so the whole suite passes. That also settles the caveat in my last message about the rest of the suite being unchecked.

The change is the same as I described before:
- `schema.sql`: new nullable `description` column on `promotion`.
- `Promotion.java`: new `description` component, with the old 6-argument constructor kept.
- `DataStore.java`: the create method and the six listing and lookup methods handle the description.

I still haven't added a migration for existing databases or a test that checks the description text.
